author: MetaBallStudios
description:
⚠️ Note: This includes cities on a planet's surface, from small towns to sprawling metropolises. Underground, aerial, and space-based cities are excluded. Many relevant examples are included in this video, but many others have to be omitted due to technical difficulties in measuring them, their lack of relevance, or simply because there are too many examples.

⚠️ Warning: It is very difficult to estimate the size of cities that do not exist; there may be discrepancies in the measurements.


~ - Approximate
± - Error range
*UM - Unreliable Measure
White texts have sources
Yellow texts are MBS estimates
Red texts are extremely imprecise MBS estimates
